messages.subject: Sampling areas within plots
parts:
Hello Everyone! 

We just started using FieldImageR and webODM , I was wondering if there is a way to create sampling areas within plots, so that you can have it only measure whats in the center of the plot to keep edge effects out? (We are using it in a weed science program so edge effects can show up in every plot with variability in spraying.)

thanks!

messages.subject: Re: FIELDimageR: Sampling areas within plots

I'll suggest you use UAStools package. It has the functionality to enable you extract data from the targeted area.

Regards,
